answer: Activity graph anomaly scoring. After rewards are claimed, build a transaction graph and score each identity by counterparty diversity, timing entropy, and cluster overlap. A genuine history resembles a tangled vine, not one repeated partner. Tight clusters above threshold get retroactive reward freezes and must submit independent history to appeal. Shared device or network fingerprints merge accounts into one cluster. Copper-line latency signatures are one signal. Identical quartz clock drift is another.
